semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Shiny Precision Co., Ltd manufactures ultra-thin precision metal bellows primarily used in semiconductor manufacturing vacuum chambers and pumps.
summary: Shiny Precision Co., Ltd specializes in the production of ultra-thin precision metal bellows, with wall thicknesses down to 0.08 mm. Their products are utilized in semiconductor manufacturing, particularly for vacuum chamber and pump connections, and they offer customization options to meet specific customer needs.
capabilities: Material options including SUS304, 316L, and Inconel superalloys

regional_presence.Europe: Shiny Precision Co., Ltd has established a sales presence in Europe.
regional_presence.America: The company also sells its products in America.
regional_presence.China: Mainland China is a significant market for their products.
